name: Notebuddy
tagline: Raise a little AI friend, explore dungeons, and make a home together.
description:
Meet one little companion and build a life together. Draw a character, upload a PNG/JPEG/WebP reference, or start with a ready-made surprise friend. Anna interprets your reference to create an illustrated companion with a saved personality, voice and habits.

Care, chat and grow
Feed, play, rest, train and share your day. Your choices shape your companion over four growth stages, with daily quests, saved memories and a growth album. You can turn off AI care reactions and AI walk narration while keeping actions, stats and rewards. Messages you send directly still use AI. Manual portrait redraw and album cleanup controls have been removed.

Your own home and garden
Step between a pixel cottage and its garden. Browse 48 objects: 12 indoor objects including the free resting nest, plus 36 garden items. Find flower beds, cherry and maple trees, benches, hammocks, ponds, fountains, lanterns and storybook accents using indoor/garden and style filters. Purchases go into storage. Choose Decorate to let your companion pick a validated layout, placing up to three objects per request. Doorways and walking routes stay clear. Undo restores the previous layout and keeps your purchases.

On your first home visit, choose one AI image request for a personal directional pixel character or a free default converted from your portrait. Reopening, moving, browsing and buying do not request AI. Decorate uses one text AI selection. Indoor furniture has a carrying animation; garden decorations appear in their finished positions.

Walks and five pixel dungeons
Follow continuing walk stories influenced by care and earlier choices. Discover Hellgate, Ice Kingdom, Dream Forest, Sunken Palace and Forgotten Clockwork City. New discovery cards appear after you finish or acknowledge the walk result. Explore rooms, make safe or risky choices, and face enemies and guardians. Regional rewards, coins and inventory are available. The item book previews 24 illustrated cosmetic designs; equipment remains planned.

AI usage and saved data
Chat, optional care replies and walk narration, personality creation, reference analysis, portrait generation, the optional home pixel character and requested decoration use your Anna AI allowance. Reference analysis and portrait generation are separate requests. Random starts use a bundled portrait but still request a personality. Failed AI requests may consume allowance. Game rules, rewards and prices are validated by Python, not invented by AI.

English and Korean are available, with themed pixel interfaces. Your companion, saved art, conversations, purchases and layouts stay in Anna storage. Confirmed reset and saved-data removal controls are included; see the privacy notice. Listing screenshots use the current UI with isolated demo data, not a live player's account.
